summary: Tests hooks/vector-store.mjs (append-only segments, compaction, sweep, refs) including two cross-process tests that spawn `node --input-type=module -e` children: a reader hammering get() while the writer appends/compacts, and a writer SIGKILLed mid-work then reopened. Symptom seen on the first Windows CI run (2026-11-22): 'Unexpected end of JSON input' in the reader test and a 30 s timeout in the SIGKILL test — the children imported the store by a bare 'C:\…' path (STORE), which Windows ESM rejects, so they died with no stdout. Children now import STORE_URL (pathToFileURL) and both tests put the child's stderr in the failure message. Passes 24/24 on macOS; the Windows result of the fix is whatever CI run 45010482125 showed (not verified at write time).
head: 812d956fa2b2
